candidate_sentence_map.S1: The group reported a decline in financial performance during the year ended December 31, 2024, amid an intensely competitive market environment and oversupply of travel services in the Baltic States.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue from contracts with customers decreased by 3.6% to EUR 200.9 million compared with EUR 208.3 million in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: The total number of travelers served across Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia declined by 7.6% to 239.5 thousand passengers compared with 259.3 thousand passengers in 2023.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Gross profit fell by 20.9% to EUR 20.7 million, down from EUR 26.2 million in 2023, while gross profit margin narrowed by 2.3 percentage points to 10.3%.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Operating expenses reached EUR 27.5 million, representing a 25% increase compared with the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: This figure includes a one-off, non-cash goodwill impairment loss of EUR 5.7 million related to the Estonian cash-generating unit.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Excluding this impairment charge, operating expenses amounted to EUR 21.8 million, marking a 1% decrease from 2023.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The group recorded a negative EBITDA of EUR 6.1 million, compared to a positive EBITDA of EUR 5.2 million in the previous period.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Adjusted EBITDA, which excludes the goodwill impairment, stood at EUR 449 thousand negative, compared with positive EUR 5.2 million in 2023.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Operating loss totaled EUR 6.7 million, compared with an operating profit of EUR 4.9 million in the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Net loss for 2024 widened significantly to EUR 7.6 million from a net profit of EUR 3.4 million in 2023, resulting in basic and diluted earnings per share of EUR 0.97 negative, compared with EUR 0.43 positive in the preceding year.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Despite weaker performance during the first half of the year, operating results showed a material improvement starting in September 2024, driven by travel program optimization, reduced dependence on last-minute sales, and a higher seat capacity utilization load factor of 98.9% in the fourth quarter compared to 96.7% in the final quarter of 2023.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Total assets stood at EUR 39.5 million at the end of 2024, down from EUR 47.6 million at the end of 2023.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Total equity decreased to EUR 8.0 million from EUR 15.7 million, affected by the net loss incurred during the period.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Borrowings increased to EUR 9.3 million, up from EUR 8.7 million in the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The group experienced non-compliance with certain financial and non-financial loan covenants as of December 31, 2024, but subsequently secured waivers from lenders and obtained additional financing, including a credit line and loans from a new strategic investor, Neset Kockar, who acquired a 23.2% stake in the company during the first stage of a planned transaction in early 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Management concluded that the going concern assumption remains appropriate based on improving operational efficiency, expected profitability recovery, ongoing restructuring initiatives, and available financing support.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K5, and K6 are fully represented with supporting sentences. K4 is missing entirely—no mention of travel demand trends to Spain, long-haul growth, or specific destination performance. K7 is also missing—no segment breakdown of flight packages, sightseeing tours, or 'other sales' performance. The summary captures most high-priority financial and operational changes but omits two medium-priority segments (K4 and K7), resulting in a 'Generally yes' rating.
